item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-30
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects recently. Notably, the `statcheck` and `oddpub` projects have focused on administrative updates and code validation, respectively, with `oddpub` enhancing its ontogenerator. Meanwhile, `docpluck` has addressed several issues, including text loss and rendering fixes, while `coarse` has added a new deep literature search feature. The `regcheck` project has resolved multiple bugs, including issues with its demo page, card preview, and ad blocker interference. Additionally, `escicheck` has been synchronized with `escicheckapp` to ensure consistency across versions. These updates demonstrate the community's commitment to improving and expanding its tools, and we look forward to seeing the impact of these changes in the future. Overall, it's exciting to see these projects interconnected and advancing together.

4 commits across 2 active repositories this week.
